claims: The 2026 Men's Frozen Four semifinals were held in Las Vegas on April 9, 2026.

Michigan defeated Minnesota Duluth 4-3 in the 2026 Men's Frozen Four semifinals.
The matchup for the 2026 Men's Frozen Four championship game is Wisconsin vs. Michigan.
The 2026 Men's Frozen Four championship game is on Saturday, April 11, 2026.
